Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: sharpen.

**What the vignettes add.** The vignettes mostly confirm and make operational: the goal is "3 foundational ORTHOGONAL axes for a domain" (be1cdc74); each is independent, a decision is judged on all three, with typically a 2-1 yin/yang balance and every element having both; yin/yang is recognised by how it appears in the domain (74cd49e5). Tensions are used because domains are "directly tensions based"; awareness of tradeoffs is for tuning (38c76e41); axes are working defaults inherited by any domain, backed by growing programme evidence (06d83ca7, 2026-11-06); a domain defines tensions while a working group holds strategy (88d0b37d); cells are relative to a boundary: divide, take yang, repeat (2ad1b8d8). Hard-to-find paradox axes lead to using the classics (878ac6a1). Open: a definition of tradeoff and its properties is still wanted (2d25d1f8).

**Proposed.** A domain that names no tensions gives its decisions nothing to test their bias against. I need each domain to carry three independent foundational axes, found by dividing its boundary into yin and yang and repeating, so a decision can be judged on each and the trade-off is tuned deliberately rather than by accident.

**Depth.** Moderate-deep: 15 vignettes mostly 2026-10 to 2026-11-07, recurring across axis, compass and domain-definition conversations.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
